annotations.text:
(Re)Configure, the final interface. Third pass, Bauhaus on paper, 3 Sept 2026.
Top row: the flat app. Rows two and three: the building app, five steps left to right, plus the Architect drawer.
Motion is part of the design: click into an artboard and reload it to see the building draw itself, the numbers count, the radar trace, the heading type. Orange = the one primary action per screen. Orange NOTE blocks are for the reader, not part of the interface.

Where the look comes from:
· Bauhaus: paper, black rules, red / blue / yellow, circles and triangles as controls, a flat square-cut condensed face (Big Shoulders) with Jost (a Futura cousin) for reading
· BASEBORN: heavy uppercase, a clock in the bar, hover that moves
· Critical Danger: the headline arrives out of a blur, one hot colour
· SearchSystem: tiny mono labels, slashes, numbered everything, corner marks on frames
· anime.js: instrument rings with tick marks, typed-in text, numbers that count
· Smithsons' Soho House: as found. The building is drawn as lines first, skin second.
